mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal damage; foscarnet may also increase aminoglycoside levels by reducing renal clearance, elevating nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and amikacin levels closely, ensure adequate hydration, and consider alternative antivirals or aminoglycosides with lower nephrotoxic potential.
